title: Authorized native Windows audio qualification runner

capture.const: shared-mode render endpoint loopback normalized to interleaved f32

const: authorization is evaluated before any process, network, or audio operation
endpoint identity is accepted only through a protected environment and retained only as SHA-256
the staged Renderer, probe, scenario driver, Server peer executable and input contracts are independently hashed and never rebuilt
capture starts only for the exact render endpoint with WASAPI loopback
state and capture events are subscribed before mutation and awaited with bounded timeouts
all resources are released before successful exit
